text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio has been throwing herself
into her
training for the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nice! That was a great sprint session.
Next up is
corner drills, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since I've got a lot of energy left, I
should work
on my turns for the last
spurt too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okay! Huuup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio's skills seem to be steadily
improving.
Today's been very
productive.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nice work today, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready for a bath and some food! I
wonder
what's on the menu tonight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio comes to a halt and stares off
at...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I must push myself even harder!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...McQueen's still at it today too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. I'm in great shape right
now, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just answer me! I'm getting stronger
every day,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants me to affirm her skill, but
there's really
no need...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's what I thought! Okay!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Um... I want to do a scrimmage with
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's really getting to me! What Prez said
that time!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How I'll never be able to beat McQueen,
no
matter how many times we race...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, please! Let me race a scrimmage
against
McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, as her trainer, I'm
interested to see
how such a race would
play out myself. I give her
permission to
do the scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm all ready to go! You better
watch
yourself, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I could say the same to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm in no position to lose, after all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The scrimmage against Mejiro McQueen
begins...

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen keeps her lead going
into the
fourth corner!

text_block_list.name: Caster Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio just can't keep up! The gap
keeps on
widening and... Mejiro
McQueen reaches the
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Victory is mine.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
M-McQueen! You gotta tell me when
you decide
what race you're entering
next!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And what will you do then?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll take you on again, duh! I'm beating
you next
time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...A pointless notion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times you face me,
the
outcome will never change. I will
always win.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: They were right... I couldn't beat her.
choice_data_list: 強かったな、マックイーン……
強かったね、マックイーン……

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why Prez was so sure McQueen
would
win...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She knew I'd lose... Said it was because I
was
lacking something...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Over the past few days, Teio has been
working
toward the Japan Cup with a
strong, positive
attitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, these events might make
things a little
more complicated.
